testsuite.name: com.crush.mobile.ui.navigation.ShellNavigationTest

testcase.name: switching destinations never duplicates and back returns to chat
phone shows the bottom bar and opens each destination
rail opens Chat when the switch is allowed
a running project vetoes the Chat switch
the chat entry survives a detour so a live run is not torn down
extended rail vetoes the Chat switch when a run is in flight
non-primary routes render without shell chrome
back from settings returns to the conversation
rail replaces the bottom bar from 600dp
extended rail opens Chat when the switch is allowed
bottom bar vetoes the Chat switch when a run is in flight
rail vetoes the Chat switch when a run is in flight
a project chat highlights Crush Code and Chat resets the binding
bottom bar opens Chat when the switch is allowed
rapid destination taps leave exactly one entry above chat
